attr.title: Pocket Vectors Probe
attr.desc: Measures the handheld for the Pocket Vectors project: libc, SDL and OpenGL ES details, controller buttons and sticks, GPU and CPU speed. Writes probe_report.txt.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Follow the on-screen prompts (about 2 minutes), then send back probe_report.txt from the flightsimprobe folder.
